issues.title: Ingest the FY2026-27 adopted budget
issues.detail: The Town Commission adopted next year's budget and millage at its September 2026 hearings. Next step: download the final budget resolution and budget book from the town's Town Commission page and turn them into a money trail, by fund, that foots to the dollar.

issues.title: The millage rate, and who else taxes a Melbourne Beach home
issues.detail: A Melbourne Beach tax bill carries the town's millage plus Brevard County, the school board, and special districts. Next step: the town's final millage resolution and the Brevard County Property Appraiser's millage table.

issues.title: Last year's budget for comparison (FY2025-26)
issues.detail: Resolution 2025-15 adopted the FY2025-26 budget on Sept. 25, 2025. Its hearing packet is linked in the document library. Next step: download and parse it, so the two years can be compared line by line.

issues.title: Audited financial statements
issues.detail: Florida towns file an annual audit with the state Auditor General. Next step: pull the latest Melbourne Beach audit from flauditor.gov and compare budgeted to actual.
